geometry.meshFormat: native VTP transformed to Ground at the default state and quantized to 0.01 mm for the web

controlTable.status: atlas-data.js compatibility data only; not the displayed ROM definition or geometry

bodyLabels: Visible labels use the exact right-model Body names. The lunate, scaphoid, pisiform and triquetrum VTP meshes all belong to proximal_row. Non-hand carrier and proximal-arm bodies are not shown in the ROM viewport.
rendering: Bones and all 43 neutral muscle GeometryPaths are exported from the native right-hand model. Joint names, coordinate names and ranges, axes, CMC coupling, and default-pose moment-arm associations come from the same model. ROM remains prescribed display kinematics rather than a browser-native OpenSim force or dynamics solve. The source package declares REVIEW status and no participant scaling.
